title: Oil And Gas Law Ii
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for the day to day running of operations under the joint venture."
An operator is responsible for the day to day running of operations under the joint venture.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means non other than factual control."
De facto control means non other than factual control.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of Divisions and Departments."
The Secretariat is made up of Divisions and Departments.
fib: ______ is a fine estimated along the value of the goods, or to imprisonment for two years or both.
The penalty on conviction is a fine estimated along the value of the goods, or to imprisonment for two years or both.
______ is a member of the oil cartel known as Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC).
Nigeria is a member of the oil cartel known as Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC).
